one_line: Indian freedom fighter-turned-diplomat and first woman President of the UN General Assembly.

appearance.age_look: Early 50s, medium height, poised build with upright posture and calm, assured movements.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp cheekbones, wheatish complexion, straight refined nose, arched brows and large thoughtful eyes; default expression is composed and dignified with a slight knowing half-smile that can turn steely when determined.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair with a few soft grey strands, parted slightly off-center and pulled back into a low, smooth bun at the nape; front kept neat without loose curls; no headscarf, but sometimes a thin off-white dupatta edge frames the head.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate mid-20th century Indian diplomat’s sari: a finely woven off-white handloom cotton sari with a narrow deep-navy blue border accented by a thin gold stripe, worn in a modest Nivi drape that fully covers the torso and falls to the ankles; matching plain navy blouse with elbow-length sleeves and high round neckline; a simple, well-tailored mid-thigh-length dark charcoal wool coat (for New York/Moscow settings) left open to show the sari pleats; minimal jewellery—small round gold stud earrings, a slim gold wristwatch, and a single thin gold bangle on her right wrist; soft low-heeled closed black leather shoes; occasionally a light woolen shawl in muted grey folded over one forearm when outdoors.
appearance.signature: A slim dark-brown leather diplomatic folder clutched in one hand, often held against her torso, with a visible corner of cream-colored paper peeking out and a simple black fountain pen clipped to its edge.

ref_desc: Vijayalakshmi Pandit is a dignified early-50s woman with an oval wheatish face, neat low bun, off-white sari with deep navy-gold border, charcoal coat, minimal gold jewellery, black shoes, and a dark-brown leather diplomatic folder with pen as her constant prop.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Vijayalakshmi Pandit: an early-50s Indian woman with an oval wheatish face, sharp cheekbones, calm intelligent eyes and a composed, slightly smiling expression, her thick black hair with a few greys parted off-center and pulled into a smooth low bun at the nape. She wears an off-white handloom cotton sari with a narrow deep navy blue border edged in thin gold, draped in a modest Nivi style that covers her torso and reaches her ankles, over a matching plain navy blouse with elbow-length sleeves and a high round neckline. Over this, add a well-fitted dark charcoal wool coat to mid-thigh, worn open so the sari pleats are visible, and on her feet closed low-heeled black leather shoes. Keep jewellery minimal: small round gold stud earrings, a slim gold wristwatch, and one thin gold bangle on her right wrist; optionally show a folded muted grey wool shawl over one forearm. Her signature prop is a slim dark-brown leather diplomatic folder held in one hand against her torso, with a corner of cream paper and a simple black fountain pen clipped to its edge. Use a palette dominated by off-white, deep navy blue, charcoal grey, black and muted gold, and present her in a few neutral poses to clearly show face, hair, full costume and the folder from head to toe.
